info.title: PropManager canonical DTOs (iOS codegen input)
info.description: Auto-generated from openapi.canonical.yaml and the named swag components. Regenerate via `npm run write:ios-yaml`.

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 alpha code (wire may vary casing; upstream normalisation is server-side).

MoneyAmount.description: Monetary value in indicated currency field.

data.description: Single-resource payload wrapped by `/v1` success envelope.

PropertyStatus.description: Operational status. `archived` is legacy; new clients use `archived_at` and archive/restore endpoints.

archived_at.description: Non-null when the property is excluded from active portfolio lists and aggregate calculations.

iin.description: Kazakhstan individual identification number (ИИН); 12 digits with a valid check digit. Unique per owner among live tenants.

UtilitiesPaidBy.description: Who pays recurring utilities during the lease (CHECK on DB).

LeaseContract.description: Lease as returned by API (POST/PUT/Get lease).

PaymentSchedule.description: One expected rent instalment for a lease. DB stores status in Pending/Matched/Paid/Skipped. GET list may derive display status "overdue" when unpaid and past due (see docs/architecture/payments-and-analytics.md).

PaymentScheduleListEnvelope.description: Root JSON for paginated lease payment schedule lists (e.g. GET /v1/leases/:id/payment-schedule): ADR-104 list shape with typed rows.

PaymentQueueItem.description: One upcoming installment in the cross-portfolio payment queue (GET /v1/payment-queue), enriched with property and tenant context. Extends PaymentSchedule with the same fields plus locators.

PaymentQueueListEnvelope.description: Root JSON for the cross-portfolio payment queue (GET /v1/payment-queue): ADR-104 list shape.

PaymentScheduleUpdateRequest.description: Body for PATCH /v1/payment-schedules/:id. Exactly one intent is applied per call: due_day rewrites the lease payment day and regenerates the schedule; expected_amount rewrites the lease rent and regenerates the schedule; action="skip" drops a single installment from the queue; action="restore" puts an installment back into the queue as pending — undoing a skip, or reverting a recorded payment (which deletes the linked rent income transaction and tenant payment).

PaymentScheduleAllocation.description: One payment applied to a single schedule row (GET /v1/payment-schedules/:id/allocations), oldest first. Reversing an allocation is DELETE /v1/payments/:id, which soft-deletes the linked income transaction and recalculates the schedule's pending/partial/paid status without unwinding the whole schedule (GAP-048).

PaymentScheduleAllocationListEnvelope.description: Root JSON for GET /v1/payment-schedules/:id/allocations: ADR-104 list shape.

NotificationsPageEnvelope.description: Root JSON body of GET /v1/notifications (Fiber handler): data, page, per_page, total, unread_count.

NotificationUnreadCountData.description:
Inner object inside the HTTP "data" field for GET /v1/notifications/unread-count
(standard JSON helper wraps payload as { "data": { "count": … } }).

OverduePaymentItem.description: One overdue rent installment in GET /v1/analytics/overdue-payments.

iin.description: Kazakhstan individual identification number (ИИН); 12 digits with a valid check digit. Unique per owner among live tenants.

is_historical.description: Create an ended historical occupancy record; requires end_date and does not create rent schedule.

LeaseUpdateRequest.description: PUT /v1/leases/:id body (handlers updateLeaseRequest). All optional for partial updates.

SchedulePaymentResult.description: Wrapped in `data` after mark-paid; aligns with SchedulePaymentResponse.

contract_date.description:
ContractDate (YYYY-MM-DD) overrides the date printed on the contract;
default: signed_on, else start_date.

formats.description: Formats is any of "pdf", "docx"; empty means both.

download_url.description: DownloadURL is a signed link, absent when the server could not sign one.

activate.description:
Activate makes the lease active; signed_on defaults to today and
activation_date to start_date.

confirm.description: Confirm is required from an assistant token when replaces_lease_id is set.

generate_contract.description:
GenerateContract=true answers 501 CONTRACT_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE: render the
document with POST /v1/leases/{id}/contract after the settle.

signed_on.description: SignedOn marks the lease signed (status pending_signature, signed_on set).

source.description: Source is the client: web or ios. An assistant token always records assistant.

chat_id.description: ChatID is the Telegram chat id: negative for groups and supergroups.

code.description: Code is shown once; the owner sends it to the bot as /start <code>.

deep_link.description:
DeepLink opens a private chat with the bot; GroupDeepLink lets the owner pick a group to
add the bot to. Both are null when TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME is not configured.

by_property.description: ByProperty is present for the portfolio call (no property_id) only.

rows.description: Rows follow group_by: one per service type or per month "01".."12".

skipped_property_ids.description: SkippedPropertyIDs are properties left out of a per_sqm portfolio call because they have no area.

type_rows.description:
TypeRows are the rows by service type whatever group_by is (the same as Rows for group_by=type), so
the total and the breakdown by service are always there.

unconverted_lines.description:
UnconvertedLines counts bill lines without a base-currency amount (no exchange rate); they are
missing from the amounts.

missing_months.description:
MissingMonths are the months (YYYY-MM) of year and compare_year, up to the current month, where a
bill is expected (an expectation rule or a bill of any status exists) but none is confirmed or paid.

months_with_bill.description: MonthsWithBill counts the months of `year` that have a confirmed or paid bill.

type_rows.description: TypeRows are the rows by service type whatever group_by is.

unit.description: Unit is the consumption unit (metric=consumption only).

delta_pct.description: DeltaPct is null when the previous value is 0.

mixed_units.description:
MixedUnits is true when metric=consumption covers several units: such values are not added up
and Current/Previous/DeltaAbs are 0.

unit.description: Unit of a consumption total; null for amounts and for consumption in mixed units.

total.description: Money in major units (e.g. 380000 or 1234.56), at most 2 decimal places.

max_items.description: MaxItems is the most line items a bill takes.

max_notes_len.description: MaxNotesLen is the longest notes text.

period_min.description: PeriodMin is the earliest period, YYYY-MM.

total_paid.description: Money in major units (e.g. 380000 or 1234.56), at most 2 decimal places.

default_unit.description: DefaultUnit is the unit a consumption of this type is usually printed in ("" = none).

order.description: Order is the position in the lifecycle (1 = expected).
